llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple hallmark scam characteristics: it fakes celebrity and media endorsements (Rob Brydon, BBC, Richard Branson, Elon Musk, Bill Gates), offers promises of huge, guaranteed profits ("tens of thousands of pounds a day," "risk-free"), uses urgent calls to action ("sign up now," "limited spots"), requests an upfront deposit (£190 minimum), and uses manipulative testimonials and narratives to exploit psychological weaknesses. It mimics legitimate media, offers a 'wealth loophole' narrative, and claims to hand out profits easily—matching the classic cryptocurrency/investment scam template.
